passivas.descricao: Oponentes com menos Gnosis nao jogam Combat Action no round 1
Enticer nao pode bluff com Combat Actions de Rage > 6

_metadata.texto_original: Opponents who have less Gnosis than the Enticer cannot play a Combat Action during the first round of combat.  The Enticer cannot bluff with Combat Actions which exceed Rage 6.
